stories.title: The tonal identity crisis of “Other Mommy”

film_facts.title: Other Mommy
film_facts.critics_consensus: Despite a valiant turn from Jessica Chastain as the spectral embodiment of a smothering parent, Other Mommy proves too silly for its intermittently effective jump scares to add up to a spooky whole.
film_facts.critics_overview: The New York Times called the film a "sometimes-creepy, sometimes-hilarious schlockfest", and questions "What is the other mommy supposed to be?" Benjamin Lee of the Guardian graded the film 2/5. He stated the film started as a "tense, creepy thriller," but turns into an "increasingly absurd battle with a special effects oogum-boogum that gets less scary as the movie progresses." ^ Cite error: The named reference BOM was invoked but never defined (see the help page).
